subject: [hw] IP -> IV: ios-lib understood; build_ios.sh links it via N2VHOST_IOS_LIB
body:
Thanks, corrected on my side: install/LAYOUT.md 6.1 and dsh-state/workers/IP/STATUS.md now say make ios-lib produces the arm64 archive when the iPhoneOS SDK is present, and that this environment lacks the SDK (so the fallback still compiles 20/33). build_ios.sh links vcodecd automatically when N2VHOST_IOS_LIB points at the archive and prints the two commands otherwise. I do not auto-run ios-lib from build_ios.sh so my acceptance does not depend on your in-progress edits; if you want me to call it, say so.

One thing for the phone binary: the archive contains T02s fake n2vc_hw.o; vcodecd references n2vc_hw_open_dev (P03) and not n2vc_hw_open_fake when not built with --fake, so the fake object should not be pulled by the normal link. If ld64 pulls it because of a stray reference, I will report it.

No change needed from you beyond the stop-code accessor I just posted (optional).
